reasoning: The complete bipartite graph K_{5,5} with partitions {0,1,2,3,4} and {5,6,7,8,9} is a maximal triangle-free graph on 10 vertices. It has 25 edges (the maximum possible for a triangle-free graph on 10 vertices by Turán's theorem). It is triangle-free because all edges go between partitions, and no edges exist within a partition. It is maximal because adding any missing edge (between two vertices in the same partition) would create a triangle with any vertex from the opposite partition.
